nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=75 beats='Priya and Arjun wake to fresh snow on their street; their boots sit by the door, ready for sledding on Meadow Hill; after three runs down the sled run, Arjun realizes one boot is missing'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=60 beats='Priya feels worried; she must decide: should she search alone first, or should she get Mom to help right away'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='Priya climbs back up Meadow Hill; she sees three possible paths the boot could have taken down the slope'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=64 beats='Priya runs home and finds Mom making cocoa; Mom listens and grabs her coat; they head back to the hill together'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=69 beats='The left slope is steep; Priya carefully walks down and spots something caught in bramble bushes; she climbs through and finds Arjun's boot'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='Priya follows the main sled path down; she sees a flash of red fabric in the snow near the bottom'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='Priya and Mom walk down the main path together; Mom spots the boot at the bottom near the fence; they pull it free from the snow'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=68 beats='Priya arrives home with the muddy boot held high like a prize; Arjun cheers and hugs her; Mom makes hot cocoa and calls Priya brave and clever'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Priya brushes away the snow and finds a lost scarf, not the boot; disappointed, she continues down to the very bottom'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=66 beats='At the bottom near the fence, Priya spots her brother's boot lying in a snow bank; it is wet but in one piece'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=66 beats='At home, Priya and Mom rinse the boot while Arjun watches excited; Mom hugs Priya and says good teamwork solved the puzzle'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=68 beats='Priya races home with the wet boot; Arjun jumps with joy when she arrives; that night they celebrate with cocoa'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=62 beats='The sun is setting and snow falls faster; Priya has searched but found no boot; she feels tired and hears Mom calling'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=66 beats='As darkness falls, Priya spots something glinting near the brambles; she climbs down and finds the boot'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=64 beats='Priya runs home as darkness falls; Mom is waiting; without hesitation, Mom gets her coat'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=66 beats='Priya arrives home frozen but victorious; Mom wraps her in blankets; they celebrate with the biggest cup of cocoa ever'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=65 beats='With the flashlight, Priya and Mom search the slope; the beam catches something in the brambles; Mom frees the boot'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=65 beats='Priya holds the boot tight as they walk home in darkness; inside, the family sits by the stove and Priya tells the whole story'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=62 beats='Priya has searched everywhere but the boot seems lost; evening falls and fresh snow covers the slope'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=62 beats='At dinner, Mom says they will buy new boots; Priya feels sad but knows she tried very hard'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=60 beats='Morning brings sunshine; Priya wakes determined; she eats breakfast and asks Mom to search'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=64 beats='In the bright morning, the boot is easier to spot; Priya and Mom quickly see it at the bottom'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=62 beats='At home, Arjun promises to care for his boots; Priya feels proud; the family celebrates with a special dinner'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=64 beats='Priya walks down the slope looking carefully; she trips over something hard in the snow'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=64 beats='She finds the boot right in the middle of the path; Priya laughs at her luck; she takes it home and celebrates'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=60 beats='Priya sits at the top of the hill; from here she can see the whole slope'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=58 beats='Priya takes a break and looks down the slope; she takes a deep breath and chooses her next path'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=60 beats='Priya searches the right side with the pine trees; the snow is very deep and quiet here'>>

choices.label: Go back and check the main path

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=59 beats='Priya walks down the slope slowly, looking at every shadow and bump in the snow'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=60 beats='Priya searches the left side again more carefully this time looking at every detail'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=60 beats='Priya thinks hard about where Arjun sledded most and searches that area very carefully'>>
